title: RateGain Reboot
overview: A full brand reboot for RateGain — the world's leading SaaS provider for travel and hospitality. We rebuilt the identity system, redesigned the marketing site and aligned product, sales and event design under one expressive system.
challenge: After two decades of growth and acquisitions, RateGain's visual language no longer reflected the scale, sophistication and ambition of the company. The brand needed to feel like a category leader without losing approachability.
solution: We crafted a confident, typography-led identity grounded in an editorial grid. A new wordmark, motion language, color palette and component library now power everything from product UI to event keynotes.
process: Brand audit across 14 sub-brands and acquired products
Identity workshops with leadership and product
Logo, type system and color exploration
outcome: Launched at WTM London with a refreshed brand site, sales collateral and a hero film. Internal NPS for the brand jumped from 42 to 78 within a quarter.

title: Rev AI Studio Branding
overview: Rev-AI Studio is RateGain's generative-AI suite for revenue teams. The brand needed to signal intelligence and trust while staying part of the RateGain master brand.
challenge: Position a new AI sub-brand inside an established enterprise identity — without it feeling like another bolt-on AI product.
solution: A monochrome, spectral identity built around a generative mark, paired with a calm product UI focused on signal-over-noise dashboards.
outcome: Launched with three flagship modules. Featured by Skift and PhocusWire as one of travel's most credible AI plays of 2024.

title: Future of Travel — Dubai
overview: A flagship invite-only summit in Dubai bringing together CEOs of the world's largest travel brands. End-to-end creative for stage, print, digital and film.
challenge: Create an event identity that felt as premium as the audience — heads of revenue and distribution from Marriott, Accor, Emirates and more.
solution: A cinematic, dune-inspired visual system with kinetic typography, gold-on-black palette and a custom title sequence projected on a 30m LED wall.
outcome: 180+ C-level attendees. Highest-rated RateGain event to date.

title: OPTIMA dataSURE
overview: Launch campaign and product UI refresh for OPTIMA dataSURE — a data integrity layer for hotel revenue managers.
challenge: Make a deeply technical data-quality product feel essential to a non-technical revenue audience.
solution: Reframed the product around three customer outcomes — clean, complete, confident — and built a launch system around each.
outcome: 120% of pipeline target hit in Q1 post-launch.

title: Drive Report
overview: A 60-page annual research report on demand, distribution and revenue trends in global travel.
challenge: Make a dense industry report feel like an editorial product — something you'd want to read cover to cover.
solution: Magazine-style grid, custom data visualizations, and a colour-coded chapter system. Designed in print and as an interactive web experience.
outcome: Most downloaded RateGain report ever — 12,000+ downloads in 60 days.

title: Elite Havens Case Study
overview: A long-form case study showcasing how Elite Havens, Asia's leading luxury villa brand, scaled distribution with RateGain.
challenge: Tell a quantitative success story in a visually-led, brand-appropriate way.
solution: An immersive scroll-based web story with full-bleed villa imagery, animated stats and pull quotes.
outcome: Used as the hero asset for the hospitality vertical for 18 months.

title: Roadmap to Revenue
overview: An always-on demand-gen campaign positioning RateGain as the operating system for travel revenue.
challenge: Cut through a category full of dashboards and pie charts.
solution: A bold, road-inspired visual system with kinetic typography, paired with a modular content engine for sales and marketing.
outcome: 3.2x increase in MQLs from paid channels over the campaign window.

title: ABM by Adara
overview: Brand and launch creative for Adara's account-based marketing product for travel advertisers.
challenge: Carve out a distinct identity for an ABM product inside Adara's existing data brand.
solution: A focused, target-led visual system built around precision and intent. Paired with a clean launch site and sales narrative.
outcome: Adopted by 30+ travel advertisers in the first quarter.

title: WTM London — Brand Presence
overview: RateGain's brand presence at World Travel Market London — stand, signage, content, gifting, social and after-party.
challenge: Stand out on a show floor dominated by enormous tourism-board pavilions.
solution: An editorial, gallery-style stand with a typography-led headline wall, a quiet meeting lounge and a daily printed broadsheet of insights.
outcome: 2x meeting volume vs. previous year. Stand featured in WTM's official wrap-up.
